name: NEXTAGE Co., Ltd.
summary: NEXTAGE Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of new and used cars in Japan. The company is also involved in automotive maintenance and repair services; the purchase of used vehicles; insurance agency services; on-site automobile purchasing services; car coating services; vehicle inspection services; and the sale of car accessories. It provides its products and services through its stores. NEXTAGE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
